title: Home practical guide and safety card: garden minibeast look
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Skeletons, muscles, nutrition and plants (Tribal Tales)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 19 (Home practical guide and safety card: garden minibeast look (portal worksheet; adult present, look but do not touch, wash hands))
intro: Lesson 19: Vertebrates and invertebrates. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find and sort minibeasts in a garden or park
safety: Adult present, look but do not touch, wash hands
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Look under stones, logs and leaves; put each one back gently
Look, but do not touch the animals
Count each kind of minibeast you see
Decide: does it have a backbone (vertebrate) or not (invertebrate)?
Wash your hands when you come in

questions.q: A vertebrate is an animal with...
Big question: what is the big difference inside a worm and a snake?
questions.a: The snake has a backbone; the worm does not.
